exposure: maternal age 45 years or older at time of delivery
cohort: Women with twin pregnancies who delivered at or after 45 years of age (n=139)
finding: Twin pregnancy in a predominantly healthy cohort of women who were at least 45 years old when they delivered was associated with high rates of cesarean delivery, preeclampsia, and gestational diabetes, but overall favorable outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rate was high (93.5%) in the study cohort.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery was 35.4 weeks
